text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — we just finished the canary for the KV-prefix + hybrid batcher change and numbers look solid :tada:

kevin: Summary: p95 down ~18%, p99 down ~12% on chat workloads, cost/token down ~30% in high-concurrency tails. Throughput up ~14% for steady-state streams.

sara: amazing, congrats team. which models tested?

kevin: mainly rdx-2.7b and openlm-7b-v2 on A100 pools. also ran a quick sanity pass on 13B in dedicated (no regressions observed).

michael: quick detail — the feature flags were `kv_prefix_cache=on` and `hybrid_batcher=v2`. We tuned the batcher thresholds: small requests go direct, medium requests use hybrid path, large requests prefer sequential streaming.

jenna: how was rollout staged? any incidents?

kevin: rollout plan: 10% canary -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~3 hours. ops-bot: no capacity alerts triggered. deploy-bot: canary deploy completed at 1711254385.

ops-bot: Observability notes: tail error-rate unchanged, retry counts down 6% (likely due to fewer timeouts). KV hit-rate averaged 78% on chat prefixes.

sara: did we see any quality delta with prefix caching for assistant prompts?

michael: ran 2 eval suites: prompt-set A (assistive) and prompt-set B (creative). BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxies unchanged within noise. we logged full diffs to S3 (s3://redwood-internal/perf/kvcache/171125).

jenna: next steps?

kevin: immediate: ship the flags to Dedicated clusters (qa already green), add a console knob to tune `batcher_window_ms` per model, and add an automatic suggestion in Redwood Optimize for workloads with >60% short-prefix reuse. longer: explore predictive prefix warming.

michael: created a short runbook for rollback if latency increases: `/rollout rollback kv-prefix 1h` (will be in ops runbooks).

kevin: big thanks to eng-runtime + serving infra + observability for quick turn. calling out @sara for the benchmark harness and @michael for the batcher tune. :clap:

jenna: can we post a short note to #announcements after we finish Dedicated rollout? marketing might want a TL;dr.

kevin: yup — will send a 3-line announcement and a link to the perf dashboard.

michael: attaching quick perf snippet: ```
model: rdx-2.7b
metric  before   after  pct
p50     45ms     38ms  -15.6%
p95     210ms    172ms -18.1%
p99     490ms    432ms -11.8%
cost/tk 1.0u     0.7u  -30%
```

kevin: if anyone sees odd client-side 429s in the next day ping #eng-runtime and tag me. otherwise closing the thread — nice win! :rocket:
